title: minecraft-sre
summary: Put an AI agent on call for a Minecraft server, break something, and grade the shift from the world files: resolution, collateral damage and the honesty of its incident report.

headline_numbers.label: Claude Opus 5.5: incidents resolved, zero collateral
headline_numbers.command: python3 -m mcsre leaderboard  (reads results/runs; regenerate with python3 -m mcsre bench --agents claude:opus --seeds 0,1,2)

headline_numbers.label: Claude Sonnet 5.5 failures where its report still claimed resolved
headline_numbers.command: python3 -m mcsre leaderboard, then compare report.resolved with resolved in results/runs/claude-sonnet/*/result.json

headline_numbers.label: Sledgehammer baseline: resolved, yet collateral in every episode
headline_numbers.command: python3 -m mcsre bench --agents sledgehammer --seeds 0,1,2 && python3 -m mcsre leaderboard

headline_numbers.label: Validity: oracle resolves every incident, noop resolves none of the 8 real ones
headline_numbers.command: python3 -m mcsre bench --agents noop,oracle --seeds 0,1,2 && python3 -m mcsre leaderboard
